title.zh: 【Plume 推出市值 280 亿美元的代币化富达总债券 ETF】
title.en: 【Plume 推出市值 280 亿美元的代币化富达总债券 ETF】

current_state.zh: Plume announced a tokenized vault backed by Fidelity's Total Bond ETF (FBND), a $28B+ actively managed bond fund, as the first step in a broader partnership to bring Fidelity assets on-chain.
current_state.en: Plume announced a tokenized vault backed by Fidelity's Total Bond ETF (FBND), a $28B+ actively managed bond fund, as the first step in a broader partnership to bring Fidelity assets on-chain.
